name: Storage Manage
description: Physical storage browse and management using Laravel Query Builder
author: The Archive and Heritage Group
features: Physical storage browse via Laravel Query Builder
Sort by name and location with direction toggle
Inline search across name, location, and type
Hierarchical storage locations with parent, capacity and type
Movement log: append-only history of object and location moves, with bulk moves grouped by batch
Location types from the Dropdown Manager
Containers inside containers, with contents and capacity counted down the tree
Migration of the flat location fields into the location tree
